Discovery (Nov 6-9)

  • Dropped as definition changes: math-fingerprint and browser-api-check Chrome version bumps (Nov 4), swiftshader (Nov 2), new gibberish email flags (Nov 5), harvested-proxy velocity (Nov 9), plus the usual list.
